::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 1st [1850s?]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. Photocopies lent by Barbara Dennis: Maggie/4
:::

My dear [Maggie](people/person_83.qmd)
This ought to have been your birthday but printers are slow folk, and I am a hurried one at this moment, so no more can you have now but good wishes from 

your affectionate godmother
